introduction_transcription.expected: Archive metadata can make a table look ready for a mass-metallicity census in two very different ways. If mass, gas-phase abundance, and redshift were genuinely joined within one galaxy sample, that would be a usable scientific holding. But an apparent three-axis match could instead be a fact about archive symbols and metadata, not about a galaxy sample. How do we tell a reachable table from an eligible one?
